literal: On yisi day the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, feasted the ministers, and bestowed gifts in graded measure.
idiomatic: On yisi day the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, feasted his ministers, and distributed rewards in varying amounts.

literal: Tang Meng, captain of the Feathered Forest guard, burst in proclaiming congratulations; the emperor, because Meng had violated the forbidden guard, had him beaten with the staff.
idiomatic: Tang Meng, captain of the Feathered Forest guard, rushed in to offer congratulations; the emperor had him beaten with the staff for breaching the palace guard.

literal: Meng's bearing and words were defiant; he was beheaded below the steps.
idiomatic: Meng answered with a defiant look and tone and was beheaded on the steps below.

literal: On dingwei day an edict said: "Do not wrong the solitary and weak—this principle shines in the classics of old;
idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict said, "Do not wrong the solitary and weak—this principle shines in the classics of old;

literal: show kindness to widowers and widows—its fame rests in past records.
idiomatic: show kindness to widowers and widows—its fame rests in the records of old."

literal: We, of slight virtue, serve as father and mother to the people, yet upon the masses Our heart turns and wakes to sighing anew.
idiomatic: We, of slight virtue, stand as father and mother to the people, yet when We turn to the masses Our heart wakes to sighing anew.

literal: Now the age's fortune is newly ordered and compassion has but begun: wherever there are the orphaned and aged, the sick, or those with none to rely upon, the officials shall clearly search them out and provide relief according to statute."
idiomatic: Now the age's fortune is newly ordered and compassion has only begun: wherever there are the orphaned and aged, the sick, or those with none to rely upon, the offices shall search them out clearly and provide relief according to statute."

literal: Another edict said: "When principle has a single standard, the people will not look covetously on one another;
idiomatic: Another edict said, "When principle has a single standard, the people will not look covetously on one another;

literal: when law opens two doors, officials will multiply authority and favor.
idiomatic: when law opens two doors, officials will multiply in authority and favor.

literal: Earlier rulers made statutes, later rulers made ordinances; age after age it endured, and in practice it grew ever more copious.
idiomatic: Earlier rulers made statutes and later rulers made ordinances; generation after generation it endured, and in practice it grew ever more copious.

literal: This is not how to set the measure for all ranks and dike in the ten thousand things.
idiomatic: That is not how to set a standard for every rank or fence in the myriad creatures.

literal: Let officials of the fourth rank and above assemble at the central secretariat, take all articles and statutes, and deliberate to settle on one path; those that cannot be applied, the responsible office shall suspend and record.
idiomatic: Officials of the fourth rank and above shall gather at the central secretariat, review all statutes and articles, and agree on a single course; whatever cannot be applied, the responsible office shall mark it suspended.

literal: Newly fixed statutes shall not be joined with the old system.
idiomatic: New statutes must not be linked to the old code.

literal: Let the aim be brevity and clarity, and do not produce redundancy and obstruction."
idiomatic: Seek brevity and clarity; do not allow prolixity and blockage."

literal: On jiyou day Xuan, Prince of Qinghe, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Duke of the State of the Grandee.
idiomatic: On jiyou Xuan, prince of Qinghe, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made duke of the state of the grandee.

literal: On gengxu day an edict said: "Recently in the western regions famine pressed year on year; common people drifted in displacement—some leaned their bodies in ditches and channels, others hung their lives upon the road. All were cast upon the soil and grass to satiate crows and kites.
idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict said, "Recently in the western regions famine pressed year after year; people drifted in displacement—some leaned their bodies in ditches and channels, others hung their lives upon the road. All were cast upon the soil and grass to feed crows and kites.

literal: When We think on this, it keeps Us from peaceful sleep.
idiomatic: When We think on this, the thought keeps Us from rest at night.

literal: The rite of covering exposed bones—this We truly hope for;
idiomatic: Covering exposed bones in proper rite—this We truly hope for;

literal: the duty of filling in embankments—this too We trust can be urged.
idiomatic: repairing broken embankments is also something We may urge.

literal: Wherever there are corpses left exposed, let the locality bury and cover them.
idiomatic: Wherever bodies lie exposed, the locality shall bury and cover them.

literal: Let this be proclaimed throughout the realm."
idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed throughout the realm."

literal: On yimao day an edict released strictures within and without.
idiomatic: On yimao day an edict lifted martial law within and without.

literal: Sixth month, new moon on guihai day: the emperor heard lawsuits at the Hualin Garden.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guihai new moon, the emperor heard lawsuits at the Hualin Garden.

literal: On bingyin day Rouran, Hephthalites, Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Rouran, the Hephthalites, Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On dingmao day Baoju, Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei, regional inspector of Si, and Prince of Nanyang, was reduced for an offense to general of agile cavalry and commander with open office; his princely title remained; he returned to his residence; the Feathered Forest guard was ordered to hold him.
idiomatic: On dingmao Baoju, grandee of taiwei, regional inspector of Si, and prince of Nanyang, was reduced for an offense to general of agile cavalry and commander with open office; his princely title remained; he returned to his residence under Feathered Forest guard.

literal: The posthumous title of Emperor Wuhuai was changed to Xiaozhuang.
idiomatic: The posthumous title of Emperor Wuhuai was changed to Xiaozhuang (Filial and Solemn).

literal: On guiyou day Rouran and the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On guiyou Rouran and the Hephthalites sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On wuyin day an edict granted a general promotion of six ranks to all offices within and without.
idiomatic: On wuyin an edict granted a general promotion of six ranks to every office inside and outside the capital.

literal: Capital officials received an additional four ranks for the Restoration; righteous-army commanders and soldiers likewise received a general military promotion of six ranks; officials at Ye three ranks; the Hebei provinces that joined the righteous cause two ranks; those who raised the righteous cause at Hey Bridge five ranks; Guanxi two ranks.
idiomatic: Capital officials received an additional four ranks for the Restoration; righteous-army commanders and soldiers a general military promotion of six ranks; officials at Ye three ranks; the Hebei provinces that joined the righteous cause two ranks; those who raised the righteous cause at Hey Bridge five ranks; Guanxi two ranks.

literal: All who had received enfeoffment, general promotions, and privileged ranks under Jianming and Putai were entirely revoked.
idiomatic: All enfeoffments, general promotions, and privileged ranks granted under Jianming and Putai were entirely revoked.

literal: On jimao day the emperor heard lawsuits at the Xianyang Hall.
idiomatic: On jimao the emperor heard lawsuits at the Xianyang Hall.

literal: On yiyou day Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On yiyou Goguryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingxu day Chun, former general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, was restored to his former office.
idiomatic: On bingxu Chun, former general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, was restored to his former office.

literal: An edict said: "Recently violent power waxed wanton and laws and ordinances turned irregular; they then set light levies on barbarian and border peoples, hoping to win the realm's hearts—then followed heavy extortion, and in the end collected levies tenfold; to cover the eyes and catch sparrows—how could it surpass this?
idiomatic: An edict said, "Recently violent power waxed wanton and laws and ordinances turned irregular; they set light levies on barbarian and border peoples, hoping to win the realm's hearts—then followed heavy extortion, and in the end collected levies tenfold; to cover the eyes and catch sparrows—how could it surpass this?

literal: We keep the masses in mind and cannot forget even in sleep and meals; moreover fields and mulberries are but beginning their work and livelihoods are not yet abundant—if We suddenly rely on the usual statutes, it may not fully reach.
idiomatic: We keep the masses in mind and cannot forget even in sleep and meals; moreover fields and mulberries are but beginning their work and livelihoods are not yet abundant—if We suddenly rely on the usual statutes, it may not fully suffice.

literal: This year's land tax and corvée levy shall for now be collected at two parts and remitted one; next year restores the former practice."
idiomatic: This year's land tax and corvée shall be collected at two parts with one remitted for now; next year the former practice returns."

literal: On xinmao day Xian Du, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, bearer of the staff with full powers, guard-general, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
idiomatic: On xinmao Jia Xiandu, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, bearer of the staff with full powers, guard-general, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, on yiwei day an edict said: "Recently under Yong'an the chariot of fortune bore the imperial heir; thereupon general promotions of rank were bestowed to proclaim the state's rejoicing.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiwei day an edict said, "Recently under Yong'an the chariot of fortune bore the imperial heir; thereupon general promotions of rank were bestowed to proclaim the state's rejoicing.

literal: Soon after Putai they were abruptly revoked midway.
idiomatic: After Putai they were suddenly revoked halfway through.

literal: Now the guilty are destroyed and the old statutes restored.
idiomatic: Now that the guilty are destroyed, the old statutes are restored.

literal: We should carry out the previous intent and complete the prior grace.
idiomatic: We should carry out the earlier intent and fulfill the prior grace.

literal: The princes' two ranks of general promotion may all be returned and conferred anew.
idiomatic: The princes' two ranks of general promotion may all be returned and granted again.

literal: The general promotion for Emperor Wenmu's temple should properly cease; those already received shall be reclaimed according to precedent."
idiomatic: General promotions for Emperor Wenmu's temple should cease; those already received shall be reclaimed by precedent."

literal: On gengzi day Baoju, general of agile cavalry and commander with open office, Prince of Nanyang, was made Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei.
idiomatic: On gengzi Baoju, general of agile cavalry and commander with open office, prince of Nanyang, was made grandee of taiwei.

literal: On renyin day Gao Huan led his host in from Fukou and Grand Commander Kudie Gan in from Jingxing Pass to attack Erzhu Zhao.
idiomatic: On renyin Gao Huan led his host in from Fukou and Grand Commander Kudie Gan in from Jingxing Pass to attack Erzhu Zhao.

literal: On yisi day Gao Huan sent Erzhu Tianguang and Erzhu Dulü to the capital; they were beheaded in the metropolitan market.
idiomatic: On yisi Gao Huan sent Erzhu Tianguang and Erzhu Dulü to the capital and they were beheaded in the metropolitan market.

literal: On jiyou day Zihong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing and acting grand mobile office of the southeast route, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On jiyou Fan Zihong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing and acting grand mobile office of the southeast route, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On gengxu day an edict made Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, grandee of the left halberd, bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, concurrent left vice director, and northern-route grand mobile office, to lead infantry and cavalry numbering one hundred thousand toward Mount Taihang and join Gao Huan.
idiomatic: On gengxu an edict made Gao Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, grandee of the left halberd, bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, concurrent left vice director, and northern-route grand mobile office, lead one hundred thousand infantry and cavalry toward Mount Taihang to join Gao Huan.

literal: Longzhi relinquished the mobile office and remained chief clerk of the great chancellor's army.
idiomatic: Longzhi gave up the mobile office and remained chief clerk of the great chancellor's army.

literal: Gao Huan halted at Wuxiang; Erzhu Zhao greatly plundered Jinyang and fled north to Xiurong.
idiomatic: Gao Huan camped at Wuxiang; Erzhu Zhao plundered Jinyang heavily and fled north to Xiurong.

literal: Bing Province was pacified.
idiomatic: Bing province was pacified.

literal: On yimao day the emperor entered the Xianyang Hall and personally judged cases of wrongful punishment.
idiomatic: On yimao the emperor entered the Xianyang Hall and personally judged cases of wrongful punishment.

literal: On bingchen day Guiping, Prince of Donglai, director of the imperial clan, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On bingchen Guiping, prince of Donglai, director of the imperial clan, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: That month resettled people of Xia Province: Guo Qian of You Province rebelled and occupied it; Regional Inspector Yuan Yi abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: That month resettled people of Xia province rebelled: Guo Qian of You province seized the province; Yuan Yi, regional inspector, abandoned the city and fled.

literal: [7] An edict ordered Grand Mobile Office Hou Jing to lead Qi regional inspector Wei Jing, Ji regional inspector Cai Jun, and others to attack and suppress him.
idiomatic: [7] An edict ordered Hou Jing, grand mobile office, to lead Wei Jing, regional inspector of Qi, Cai Jun, regional inspector of Ji, and others to attack and suppress him.

literal: When the city fell, Qian fled to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: When the city fell, Qian fled to Xiao Yan.

literal: Fan Zihong, grand mobile office of the southeast route, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Qiao city and captured his Prince of Ye Yuan Shu and regional inspector of Qiao Zhu Wenkai.
idiomatic: Fan Zihong, grand mobile office of the southeast route, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Qiao city and captured his prince of Ye Yuan Shu and Zhu Wenkai, regional inspector of Qiao.

literal: Eighth month, new moon on renxu day: Gao Cheng came to court; they feasted and shot together, and gifts to subordinates were graded.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renxu new moon, Gao Cheng came to court; they feasted and shot together, and gifts to subordinates were graded.

literal: On dingmao day Ning, western middle cadet-general, was made Prince of Gaoping.
idiomatic: On dingmao Ning, western middle cadet-general, was made prince of Gaoping.

literal: On jiaxu day Yan Zhi, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Yan Zhi, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On gengyin day Bing, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On gengyin Cui Bing, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On xinmao day Yue, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the right halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On xinmao Gao Yue, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the right halberd, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Ninth month, on guiwei day Jin, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei day Feng Jin, attendant-in-ordinary, general of agile cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On gengzi day the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion and received Yuan Shu and ducal ministers, the hundred offices, foreign envoys, supervisors, and generals, and feasted with archery; gifts were graded.
idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion and received Yuan Shu, ducal ministers, the hundred offices, foreign envoys, supervisors, and generals; they feasted with archery and gifts were graded.

literal: On guimao day Yun, Duke of Yan Commandery with open state, was advanced in rank to prince.
idiomatic: On guimao He Ba Yun, duke of Yan commandery with open state, was advanced in rank to prince.

literal: On yisi day the emperor visited the metropolitan waterworks, passed south over the Luo ford, and went on to the Chan and Jian streams.
idiomatic: On yisi the emperor visited the metropolitan waterworks, passed south over the Luo ford, and went on to the Chan and Jian streams.

literal: On jiyou day the hunt was resumed on the northern plain.
idiomatic: On jiyou the hunt was resumed on the northern plain.

literal: On guichou day Xin, grand preceptor and Prince of Pei, was made Prince of Guangling; Zishu, son of the former emperor's Prince of Bohai, was reassigned Prince of Pei Commandery.
idiomatic: On guichou Xin, grand preceptor and prince of Pei, was made prince of Guangling; Zishu, son of the former emperor's prince of Bohai, was reassigned prince of Pei commandery.

literal: On jiayin day Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary and general of agile cavalry, [8] and Ren Xiang were both made bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On jiayin Feng Longzhi, attendant-in-ordinary and general of agile cavalry, [8] and Ren Xiang were both made bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Zhongjing, general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Henan as Yuan, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: Yuan Zhongjing, general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Henan, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On yimao day the imperial carriage paid respects at the mountain tombs.
idiomatic: On yimao the imperial carriage paid respects at the mountain tombs.

literal: On bingchen day Rouran and Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingchen Rouran and Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengshen day Shenjun, former director of the Masters of Writing for personnel, guard-general, and Lou Zhao, general who stabilizes the army and right guard-general, were both made generals of agile cavalry and bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On gengshen Li Shenjun, former director of the Masters of Writing for personnel, guard-general, and Lou Zhao, general who stabilizes the army and right guard-general, were both made generals of agile cavalry and bearers of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Tenth month of winter, on jiazi day Zhongmi, regional inspector of Guang with bearer of the staff and full powers and guard-general, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi day Gao Zhongmi, regional inspector of Guang with bearer of the staff and full powers and guard-general, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On dingmao day Man, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On dingmao Pan Man, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On jimao day Chen, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made specially advanced, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
idiomatic: On jimao Gao Chen, general of chariots and cavalry and grandee of the left halberd, was made specially advanced, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

literal: On gengyin day Gui, general of agile cavalry and regional inspector of Si with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Gui, general of agile cavalry and regional inspector of Si with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day Dun, general of chariots and cavalry and regional inspector of Yang, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day Hu Sigun Dun, general of chariots and cavalry and regional inspector of Yang, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On dingyou day, the winter solstice, the imperial carriage performed the rites at the Round Mound.
idiomatic: On dingyou, the winter solstice, the imperial carriage performed rites at the Round Mound.

literal: On wuxu day an assembly was held for the hundred offices at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
idiomatic: On wuxu an assembly was held for the hundred offices at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

literal: On jiachen day Lang, Prince of Anding, and Ye, Prince of Donghai, were put to death for their crimes.
idiomatic: On jiachen Houfei, prince of Anding, and Ye, prince of Donghai, were put to death for their crimes.

literal: On yisi day Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On yisi Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiyou day Yue, former Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei and Prince of Runan, was made attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, and commander with open office.
idiomatic: On jiyou Yue, former grandee of taiwei and prince of Runan, was made attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, and commander with open office.

literal: Empress Dowager Hu was buried.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Hu was buried.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingyin day Jun, general of agile cavalry and director of the Censorate, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day Qi Jun, general of agile cavalry and director of the censorate, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On yihai day Zan, attendant-in-ordinary and Prince of Guangping, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
idiomatic: On yihai Zan, attendant-in-ordinary and prince of Guangping, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

literal: On dinghai day Yue, grand marshal and Prince of Runan, was killed.
idiomatic: On dinghai Yue, grand marshal and prince of Runan, was killed.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; Taichang was changed to Yongxing, taking the Taizong era name; it was soon changed to Yongxi year 1.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed; Taichang became Yongxing under the Taizong era name, soon changed to Yongxi year 1.

literal: Second month, on gengshen day Qiong, general who pacifies the east with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of Fen Province affairs, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day Zhang Qiong, general who pacifies the east with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of Fen province affairs, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On xinyou day Qianzong, Duke of the State as minister of works, was made bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office; [9] Tan, Prince of Xianyang, was made Duke of the State as minister of works.
idiomatic: On xinyou Gao Qianzong, minister of works, was made bearer of the staff with full powers, general of agile cavalry, and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office; [9] Tan, prince of Xianyang, was made minister of works.

literal: Fourth month of summer, on wuchen day an edict said that aides from the Three Offices downward and also the outer provinces must not again add regular attendant or concurrent second posts; even those already appointed were all to be revoked.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuchen day an edict said that aides from the Three Offices downward and also the outer provinces must not again add regular attendant or concurrent second posts; even those already appointed were all to be revoked.

literal: That month a man of Qing Province, Geng Xiang, raided and seized Jiao Province, killed Regional Inspector Pei Can, and joined Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: That month Geng Xiang of Qing province raided and seized Jiao province, killed Pei Can, regional inspector, and joined Xiao Yan.

literal: Fifth month, on gengyin day an edict said that where wrongful imprisonment had not been heard and the matter had passed a full year or more, all were to assemble at Hualin and the emperor would personally examine them;
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin day an edict said that where wrongful imprisonment had not been heard and the matter had passed a full year or more, all were to assemble at Hualin and the emperor would personally examine them;

literal: if the matter had passed years yet the responsible office did not list it, the persons involved might each present their own appeal;
idiomatic: if years had passed and the office did not list the case, the person might present his own appeal;

literal: if the matter involved multiple provinces and commanderies and dragged on for years through connection, they were also to report collectively to the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: if the matter ran through several provinces and commanderies and dragged on for years, it was also to be reported collectively to the Masters of Writing.

literal: On renyin day Yuan, former general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and regional inspector of Qi, was restored to bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
idiomatic: On renyin Hou Yuan, former general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and regional inspector of Qi, was restored to bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

literal: On yisi day an edict said: "The office of grandee—rank and status are honored and eminent;
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict said, "The office of grandee—rank and status are honored and eminent;

literal: the outer-quota office too is no slight post.
idiomatic: the outer-quota office too is no slight post.

literal: Yet down to clerks and attendants, concurrent titles are not one kind; high and low are muddled together, to the harm of canonical pattern.
idiomatic: Yet down to clerks and attendants titles were heaped on without limit; high and low were muddled, harming canonical pattern.

literal: From this time forward, capital officials who prefer to take small offices by formal title may be directly given the scattered designation general; those who wish to relinquish humble offices may serve as grandee or outer-quota offices—it is unsuitable to continue as before with scattered substantive concurrent titles."
idiomatic: Henceforth capital officials who prefer a small office by formal title may receive only the scattered designation general; those who wish to leave humble posts may take grandee or outer-quota office—it is unsuitable to continue scattered substantive concurrent titles as before."
